messages:
Priya (People Ops): quick heads-up 14 we've published an update to the Expense Reimbursement section in the handbook: https://handbook.redwood.ai/policies/expenses - highlights below
Raj (Finance): TL;DR for managers? any new approval thresholds?
Priya (People Ops): new bits: 1) meal cap moved to $75 for travel days, 2) clear itemization required for >$200, 3) receipts can be uploaded via mobile app (scan option), and 4) there's a mandatory 12-min microlearning for anyone who approves expenses.
Jasmine (Product): do retro claims get affected? I filed one from last month pending.
Lena (People Ops): retro claims before the effective date are grandfathered, but approvals will still need the itemized receipt rule applied. If it's missing the approver will ask for it.
Raj (Finance): auto-routing change: if a manager is on leave >7 days, expense approvals route to the team's finance backup. Please confirm backups in this sheet: https://sheets.redwood.ai/expense-backups
Jasmine (Product): @Lena added eng-product backup as @marc.finance
Priya (People Ops): good. training-bot will assign "Expense policy refresher" to approvers and anyone with approver role in HRIS. Completion required within 21 days.
training-bot: Assigned course: "Expense policy refresher" to 42 users (approvers). Due: 21 days. Link: https://lms.redwood.ai/courses/expense-refresher
Lena (People Ops): managers, once you complete or confirm backups, reply here with "ACK". We'll run a report next Tuesday to find unassigned approvers.
Jasmine (Product): ACK 14 backups set and receipts guideline noted.
Raj (Finance): I'll run `financectl audit --category expenses --period last-month` after rollout to catch anomalies.
Priya (People Ops): note for international travelers: per-diem adjustments for APAC published in the handbook section. If teams need exceptions (e.g., client-provided meals), raise a ticket to finance-ops.
training-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Expense policy refresher" will nudge uncompleted users 5 days before due date.
Lena (People Ops): we'll post a short FAQ in #docs and put a quick checklist in the handbook so approvers can validate receipts easily. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
